name: Palomar.PairOfDefinition.hasBasis_nhds_zero
statement:
theorem hasBasis_nhds_zero (P : PairOfDefinition A) : (𝓝 (0 : A)).HasBasis (fun _ : ℕ ↦ True)
    (fun n ↦ Subtype.val '' ((P.I ^ n : Ideal P.A₀) : Set P.A₀))

name: Palomar.PairOfDefinition.pow_image_isOpen
statement:
theorem pow_image_isOpen (P : PairOfDefinition A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsOpen (Subtype.val '' ((P.I ^ n : Ideal P.A₀) : Set P.A₀) : Set A)

name: Palomar.PairOfDefinition.pow_isOpen
statement: theorem pow_isOpen (P : PairOfDefinition A) (n : ℕ) : IsOpen ((P.I ^ n : Ideal P.A₀) : Set P.A₀)

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.algebraMap_A₀_subset_locSubring
statement:
theorem algebraMap_A₀_subset_locSubring (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A) :
    (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) '' (P.A₀ : Set A) ⊆
      (locSubring P T s : Set (Localization.Away s))

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.limitRestrict_continuous
statement:
theorem limitRestrict_continuous {V W : Opens ↥(SpaTop A)} (h : W ≤ V) :
    Continuous (limitRestrict R h)

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_algMap_step
statement:
theorem locNhd_algMap_step (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A) (i : ℕ) (a : A) :
    ∃ j, ∀ y ∈ locNhd P T s j,
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) a * y ∈ locNhd P T s i

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_antitone
statement:
theorem locNhd_antitone (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A) :
    Antitone (locNhd P T s)

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_invS_mem
statement:
theorem locNhd_invS_mem (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : ∀ b : P.A₀, b ∈ P.I ^ N → divByS (↑b : A) s ∈ locSubring P T s)
    {d : locSubring P T s} (hd : d ∈ locIdeal P T s ^ N) :
    divByS 1 s * ↑d ∈ locSubring P T s

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_invS_step
statement:
theorem locNhd_invS_step (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : ∀ b : P.A₀, b ∈ P.I ^ N → divByS (↑b : A) s ∈ locSubring P T s)
    (n : ℕ) (y : Localization.Away s)
    (hy : y ∈ locNhd P T s (n + N)) : divByS 1 s * y ∈ locNhd P T s n

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_leftMul
statement:
theorem locNhd_leftMul (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A) (hopen : LocOpen P T s)
    (x : Localization.Away s) (i : ℕ) : ∃ j, (locNhd P T s j : Set (Localization.Away s)) ⊆
      (x * ·) ⁻¹' (locNhd P T s i : Set (Localization.Away s))

name: Palomar.ValuationSpectrum.locNhd_mul
statement:
theorem locNhd_mul (P : PairOfDefinition A) (T : Finset A) (s : A) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ j, (locNhd P T s j : Set (Localization.Away s)) *
      (locNhd P T s j : Set (Localization.Away s)) ⊆
        (locNhd P T s i : Set (Localization.Away s))

name: Palomar.gauss_add_le
statement: theorem gauss_add_le (x y : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) : gauss (x + y) ≤ max (gauss x) (gauss y)

name: Palomar.gauss_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem gauss_eq_zero_iff {x : AddMonoidAlgebra R G} : gauss x = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: Palomar.gauss_le_iff
statement:
theorem gauss_le_iff {x : AddMonoidAlgebra R G} {C : ℝ≥0} :
    gauss x ≤ C ↔ ∀ m, ‖x.coeff m‖₊ ≤ C

name: Palomar.gauss_mul_le
statement: theorem gauss_mul_le (x y : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) : gauss (x * y) ≤ gauss x * gauss y

name: Palomar.gauss_neg
statement: theorem gauss_neg (x : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) : gauss (-x) = gauss x

name: Palomar.gauss_smul
statement:
theorem gauss_smul {K : Type u} [NormedField K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K)
    (x : AddMonoidAlgebra K G) : gauss (c • x) = ‖c‖₊ * gauss x

name: Palomar.isOpen_unitBall
statement: theorem isOpen_unitBall : IsOpen (unitBall E : Set E)

name: Palomar.isTateRing_of_scale
statement:
theorem isTateRing_of_scale (t : E) (htu : IsUnit t) (ht1 : ‖t‖ < 1) (ht0 : 0 < ‖t‖)
    (hscale : ∀ x : E, ‖t * x‖ = ‖t‖ * ‖x‖) : IsTateRing E

name: Palomar.mem_span_unitBall_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_unitBall_pow_iff {t : E} (htu : IsUnit t) (ht1 : ‖t‖ ≤ 1) (ht0 : 0 < ‖t‖)
    (hscale : ∀ x : E, ‖t * x‖ = ‖t‖ * ‖x‖) (x : unitBall E) (n : ℕ) :
    x ∈ (Ideal.span {(⟨t, ht1⟩ : unitBall E)}) ^ n ↔ ‖(x : E)‖ ≤ ‖t‖ ^ n

name: Palomar.nnnorm_coeff_le_gauss
statement: theorem nnnorm_coeff_le_gauss (x : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) (m : G) : ‖x.coeff m‖₊ ≤ gauss x

name: Palomar.nnnorm_eq_gauss
statement: theorem nnnorm_eq_gauss (x : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) : ‖x‖₊ = gauss x

name: Palomar.norm_C_mul
statement: theorem norm_C_mul (c : K) (x : JetA K) : ‖C K c * x‖ = ‖c‖ * ‖x‖

name: Palomar.norm_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem norm_algebraMap_mul {K : Type u} [NormedField K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K)
    (x : TateAlgebra K G) :
    ‖(algebraMap K (AddMonoidAlgebra K G) c : TateAlgebra K G) * x‖ = ‖c‖ * ‖x‖

name: Palomar.norm_pow_mul_of_scale
statement:
theorem norm_pow_mul_of_scale {t : E} (hscale : ∀ x : E, ‖t * x‖ = ‖t‖ * ‖x‖) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    ‖t ^ n * x‖ = ‖t‖ ^ n * ‖x‖
